scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:rust: node scripts/rust-assets.mjs && cd rust/ext && cargo run -q --manifest-path ../../vendor/oxichrome/oxichrome-cli/Cargo.toml -- oxichrome build
scripts.test:rust: cd rust && cargo test -q && cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust && npm run build:e2e && npm run test:e2e && npm run build:rust && npm run test:e2e:rust
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:e2e:rust: DIST=rust/ext/dist/chromium PW_EXPERIMENTAL_SERVICE_WORKER_NETWORK_EVENTS=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/port.e2e.ts e2e/port-migration.e2e.ts
